Name: Imaginary Corn
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Imaginary corn is sold in the Calico Desert, to which it is uniquely suited. You can imagine it growing anywhere in summer or fall, though.

Not to be confused with peaches, oranges, and [i]definitely[/i] not wheat and/or wheat by-products.

Inspired by the invisible crops from CopperSun's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9026]Sam and Vincent's Cola Shop[/url].
